name: PageCurlGraphic
src_typeComment: Renders one curling page inside any Canvas — this IS the Graphic (like Image/RawImage), so just add it to a UI GameObject and drive it via BookPageCurl. Uses its own RectTransform's rect for page size, so there's no separate width/height field to keep in sync with your layout. Requires pivot = (0, 0) (bottom-left) — the hinge (canonical localX = 0 in PageCurlMeshBuilder) must sit at the RectTransform's own local origin for BookPageCurl's mirroring (localScale.x flip) to work correctly.

src_serialized.name: gridColumns
src_serialized.tooltip: Grid density for the curl mesh — higher looks smoother but costs more vertices/triangles.

src_serialized.name: shadowDarkness
src_serialized.tooltip: Brightness multiplier applied to the page's underside as it curls past the halfway point.
